snippet.title: Immaginification Promo
snippet.description:
Remember doodling stick figures in your school notebook? Now you can control one! Run, time your jumps, and survive 10 increasingly difficult levels. Plus, you can try survival minigames and battle friends in the 1v1 Arena!  


Immaginification by TheEagle Games is available now only on itch.io:

🔗 https://theeagle-games.itch.io/immaginification
